_comment_noindex: TRUE while this is a preview: emits <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"> and a blocking robots.txt. Set to false at launch, once the dummy content is replaced and the forms are wired.
_comment_logo: The header and footer logo. Drop your real file in src/assets/images/ and point this at it - both places update. A transparent PNG or an SVG is better than a JPEG here: the logo sits on white in the header and on #0B0F19 in the footer, so a JPEG's opaque background will show as a box on the dark one.
_comment_favicon: Browser tab icon. `faviconSvg` is preferred by modern browsers when set (any size, sharp everywhere); `favicon` is the raster fallback - ideally a 32x32 PNG or .ico, since a large JPEG gets squeezed into 16px and turns to mush. `appleTouchIcon` should be a 180x180 PNG for iOS home screens. Leave a value empty and its tag is simply not emitted.
